description: This file manages heartbeat wake-up logic, including scheduling, handling wake reasons, and invoking registered handlers for heartbeat events in a system. It includes functions for enabling/disabling heartbeats, queuing wake reasons, scheduling wake events, and managing the lifecycle of the wake handler.

methods.name: areHeartbeatsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether heartbeats are currently enabled.

methods.name: setHeartbeatWakeHandler
methods.description: Registers or clears the heartbeat wake handler, returning a disposer function.

methods.name: requestHeartbeatNow
methods.description: Requests an immediate heartbeat wake with optional parameters.

methods.name: hasHeartbeatWakeHandler
methods.description: Checks if a heartbeat wake handler is registered.

methods.name: hasPendingHeartbeatWake
methods.description: Checks if there are pending wake reasons or scheduled timers.

methods.name: resetHeartbeatWakeStateForTests
methods.description: Resets internal state for testing purposes.
